title: Nothing CMF Watch 2 Pro US$29.88 (~A$43.17) Delivered @ Xiaomi CC Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Nothing CMF Watch 2 Pro US$29.88 (~A$43.17) Delivered @ Xiaomi CC Store AliExpress

[jaboday423] I have this watch, and I have Nothing app data synced to the Health Connect app.
Then I have Google Fit read access to Google Health Connect. The Nothing app updates Health Connect, but Google Fit shows more step information (over 1000 additional steps) on top of the Nothing app's data.(I have disabled Google Fit from writing, and nothing else writes to Google Health Connect.)
Anyone knows How to fix this issue (Pixel 10 Pro XL)?
[BadGiraffe] It happens on my Galaxy Watch 4.
I know I'm not helping… but I see this as a benefit. You can hatch more eggs in Pokemon Go this way.
[benjaminf] Same thing here, different watch but same method. Think it's still counting some phone steps even though I have it disabled.
[StevieRay] Does TCB honour cashback with coupon use?
[Do I NeedThis] Thanks for sharing this awesome deal Clear,is there any good brand that supports esim ? i dont want my kids to waste their time scrolling reels the phone yet want them to be contactable when required.
[Jackson] Samsung and apple are the two I know of offhand, but would be interested if there's other more budget friendly ones also
[Do I NeedThis] yeah, i have a samsung one but looking for budget friendly options, @Clear here somehow always finds the best deals on gadgets for us so I thought i'd ask. Dont want to sign up to those spacetalk things for kids, they lock you into their sim i think.
[BadGiraffe] Saw this post, started doing research, and decided to buy this: https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0GQLM2HG7?smid=ANEGB3WVEVKZB&t…
$100 for the Redmi Watch 6. Half off and seems to punch above its weight in its RRP category.
[bunnybash] I’m inclined to agree with you. This Redmi looks like a better option.
[sertse] What makes it worth more than double the price? $43 to $100. Most smart watches seem to have the same functions, the really cheap ones don't have GPS but this has GPS
[Timetraveler] Looks like they’ve increased the price to $133+
